input.title: [eval] gitops without a done-when
input.body:
# Gitops without a done-when

## Problem

Agents guess the git model of a repo because Graphban never tells them. They open PRs against main because that is what models do by default.

## Goals

Named models write the six fields. Migration assist files tracker items. Graphban does not run git itself.

## Non-Goals

No git hosting. No CI. The supervisor does not push, merge, or rebase on anyone's behalf.
